title: Seismic reinforcement.
officialText: Where a structure is assigned to Seismic Design Category C or D, in accordance with Section 1613 and where concrete and steel are used as part of the pile assembly, the concrete reinforcement shall comply with Sections 1810.1.2.3 and 1810.1.2.5 and the steel section shall comply with Section 1809.7.4 or 1810.6.4.1.
